subject: gk
question: Which of the following groups of crops is related to the Kharif season in the northern states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rice, Maize, Bajra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Kharif season__ in India typically starts with the onset of the monsoon.
 
• It varies by crop and region, beginning as early as May and ending as late as January.
 
• __It is considered to start in June and end in October__.
 
• During this season, Kharif crops are sown at the beginning of the first rains brought by the southwest monsoon.
 
• The harvest occurs at the end of the monsoon season, usually in October to November.

__
 
• Crops grown in this season include cotton, groundnut, ragi, bajra, maize, rice, and soybean, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Rabi cropping season is from November to March. These are sown in November and harvested around April-May.
 
• Crops grown in this season include green peas, mustard, barley, and wheat etc.
